description: Provision a Google Cloud Resourcemanager ResourceManagerLien via Config Connector. Fields mirror the resourcemanager.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ResourceManagerLien spec.

origin.description:
Immutable. A stable, user-visible/meaningful string identifying the origin
of the Lien, intended to be inspected programmatically. Maximum length of
200 characters.

projectRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `number` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

reason.description:
Immutable. Concise user-visible strings indicating why an action cannot be performed
on a resource. Maximum length of 200 characters.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

restrictions.description:
Immutable. The types of operations which should be blocked as a result of this Lien.
Each value should correspond to an IAM permission. The server will validate
the permissions against those for which Liens are supported.  An empty
list is meaningless and will be rejected.
e.g. ['resourcemanager.projects.delete'].

title: GCP Resourcemanager ResourceManagerLien
